description: ABI-encode values for a given Solidity function/constructor signature (cast abi-encode)

args.description: Values to encode, matching the signature types in order, e.g. ["0x1234...", "1000000"]

signature.description: Solidity function or constructor signature, e.g. "constructor(address,uint256)" or "transfer(address,uint256)"

name: cast_abi_encode
